name: glab
description: GitLab CLI - manage repos, merge requests, pipelines, CI/CD variables and releases from the terminal via the GitLab API

glab.description: GitLab command-line client: API access, merge requests, pipelines, CI/CD variables, releases
glab.usage:
glab auth login --hostname code.siemens-energy.com --token <PAT>   # authenticate to a self-managed GitLab
GITLAB_HOST=code.siemens-energy.com GITLAB_TOKEN=$(cat ~/.oam-secrets/code-siemens.pat) glab variable get OAM_SECRETS_prd_OAM_2 -g mosaic-apps/oam/infrastructure/deployments/eks-helm-chart   # read a CI/CD File variable
glab ci list -R mosaic-apps/oam/infrastructure/deployments/eks-helm-chart   # list recent pipelines
glab ci run -b develop -R <project> --variables DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT:qa   # trigger a pipeline
glab mr list   # list merge requests in the current repo
